messages:
Mia: Quick kick-off for this week's GPU capacity forecast — spotted a potential 15–25% uplift in inference hours across NA and EU for the next 2–3 weeks (marketing promo + holiday traffic). Please share risk/mitigation ideas.
Alex: Do you have region-by-region deltas yet? rough numbers please. :eyes: 
Mia: Short table below (weekly GPU-hours est): us-west-2/gpu-pool-A 24,000 -> 28,000 (+17%), us-east-1/gpu-pool-B 18,500 -> 22,600 (+22%), eu-central-1/gpu-pool-C 12,200 -> 15,300 (+25%), ap-southeast-1 spare capacity low (~3k baseline, limited burst).
Raj: Ok — ap-southeast is the tight spot. We should avoid cross-region long-lived KV cache moves; egress costs spike. Proposal: 1) pre-warm 120 GPUs in eu-central for ap-southeast overflow, 2) enable spot-backed burst in us regions, 3) short-term soft queue (5s extra latency) for non-interactive jobs.
Chris: Cost impact estimate? rough $/week for pre-warm?
Mia: Pre-warm 120 GPUs in eu-central ~ 120 * 24 * 7 * 0.65 = ~13,176 GPU-hours (approx) — at our blended cost that's ~ $37k/week. Spot-backed burst could shave 40% off that for non-latency-critical workloads.
Sophie: Can we push some heavy batch reranks to off-peak windows? Marketing peak is 12:00–18:00 PST. Shift reranks 00:00–06:00 UTC would help but needs product sign-off.
Raj: Operational checklist: a) increase Dedicated burst cap in NA by +10% for 2 weeks, b) enable spot fallback policy (max 30% of burst), c) schedule node maintenance freeze during promo window. Anyone object?
Alex: No objection. Please add fallback SLOs so we don't degrade critical customers — set latency guardrails: p50 target unchanged, p95 max +200ms.
Mia: I'll open the rollout: canary to 10% traffic for first 6 hours then scale. Also putting config below for spin-up script.
capacity-bot: run command queued: ```./redwood-capacity spinup --region eu-central-1 --pool gpu-pool-C --gpus 120 --type reserved --tag winter-surge-2026```
Chris: Small concern — last month eu-central had a network flakiness event when adding new nodes (packet drops on 10G links). We should coordinate with eng-network and keep 30% headroom until we validate NIC firmware.
Mia: Good call. I'll loop in @eng-network and set the headroom. Plan: spin-up 60 GPUs tonight (smoke + network validation), if green, proceed to the rest tomorrow morning.
Raj: I'll draft cost-approval note for finance (include spot savings scenarios).
Sophie: Product will confirm which reranks can be deferred — ping me when you have the exact window.
Mia: TL;DR: forecasted +15–25% GPU-hours; short-term mitigation = partial pre-warm in EU, spot fallback, soft-queue for non-critical jobs, and CANARY rollout. Action items: Mia (spin-up 60), Raj (finance note), Chris (coordinate network), Alex (SLO config). :white_check_mark:
